description: This file defines the InjectedApplication class, which extends Android's Application class, and manages a Dagger ObjectGraph for dependency injection in an Android app.

classes.name: InjectedApplication
classes.description: Android Application subclass that initializes and manages a Dagger ObjectGraph for dependency injection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ObjectGraph during application startup.

methods.name: initObjectGraph
methods.description: Sets up the ObjectGraph with the specified module for dependency injection.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Injects dependencies into the specified object using the ObjectGraph.
